Implemented `head <count>` end-to-end.

Changed:
- [src/Slice/SliceApplication.cs](/tmp/codex-implement-05.DkAw81/project/src/Slice/SliceApplication.cs)
- [src/Slice/CsvColumnSelector.cs](/tmp/codex-implement-05.DkAw81/project/src/Slice/CsvColumnSelector.cs)
- [tests/Slice.Tests/SliceApplicationTests.cs](/tmp/codex-implement-05.DkAw81/project/tests/Slice.Tests/SliceApplicationTests.cs)

What it does:
- Adds `slice <csv-file> head <count>`.
- Preserves the header row.
- Streams only the first `N` data rows in original order.
- Outputs all rows if the file has fewer than `N` data rows.
- Fails with an error for zero or negative counts.
- Updates usage text to include `head`.

Implemented `groupby` end to end.

What changed:
- Added `groupby` to command parsing and usage text in [SliceApplication.cs](/tmp/codex-implement-08.NqlBin/project/src/Slice/SliceApplication.cs#L5).

Implemented output-format support end to end.

- CLI parsing now accepts `--format csv|json|table` and defaults to `csv` in [`src/Slice/SliceApplication.cs`](#L5-L181).
- Command execution now returns internal result objects instead of writing directly, so the computed data stays the same while rendering changes in [`src/Slice/CsvColumnSelector.cs`](#L32-L403) and [`src/Slice/QueryResult.cs`](#L3-L20).
- Rendering is centralized in [`src/Slice/OutputRenderer.cs`](#L14-L198):
  - `csv` renders tabular results with headers
  - `json` renders tabular results as arrays of objects
  - `table` renders a human-readable table
  - scalar aggregates stay single-value outputs unless the format needs structure
- Updated and added tests for grouped headers plus `json` and `table` rendering in [`tests/Slice.Tests/SliceApplicationTests.cs`](#L283-L1019).
